Usage: acpx exec [options] [prompt...]

One-shot prompt using codex by default

Arguments:
  prompt                       Prompt text

Options:
  -f, --file <path>            Read prompt text from file path (use - for stdin)
  --config-option <key=value>  Set an ACP session config option before the
                               one-shot prompt (repeatable)
  -h, --help                   display help for command
